title: A weapon material preference did not immediately replace an old assignment
claim: Changing one soldier's weapon preference to steel left his old copper weapon assigned and held. After that specific old claim was released using the installed uniform tool's assignment-removal pattern, the engine assigned an existing steel hammer and performed ordinary pickup.
reproduction: Compare the preference rule, assigned-item list and actual inventory role separately. On a disposable backed-up game, review the installed version's uniform tooling before releasing a stale claim. Then verify normal pickup and whether the item is wielded or merely strapped.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
The steel rule initially coexisted with the copper item's assignment.
A later native snapshot showed the steel hammer assigned with PickupEquipment; subsequent inventory inspection found it strapped. No item was spawned or moved directly onto the unit.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. This is version-specific structure behavior, not a portable equipment script. Releasing an assignment is not evidence of immediate battle readiness, and an in_inventory flag can describe a contained item.
